text: SUPERSEDED before confirmatory data collection (orchestrator, 2026-09-21). Truthful state: 2 model-arm pilot runs COMPLETED under this v1 registration (M008_haiku_kernel_a, M008_haiku_rules_a; subagents, prompt-blind, not hook-enforced; scored and read by the orchestrator) and 2 launch attempts failed on 'Credit balance is too low'. They are archived unmodified in runs/_pilot_M008v1_superseded/ and are NOT confirmatory data. Reasons for supersession: driver accepted malformed/duplicate init and proposals and mutated state on rejection, had no concurrency control, accepted fabricated evidence ids; the blind guard authorized by suffix regex (absolute-path, symlink, unicode-digit, trailing-newline escapes) and failed open on malformed payloads; the answer key was importable from the arm-facing simulator module; prereg.py addenda could silently re-freeze changed code. Any v2 must be written knowing the two pilot outcomes and must say so.
